note: Rule data for email triage at Dyzania LLP (fictional). Edit the data here, not the code. The courts and law firms named are invented.
knownCourtNote: Mail from these domains is treated as a court notice: priority high or more, never answered, handed to extraction. The sender address is NOT authenticated here (no SPF/DKIM check), so a forged address can only make a message more careful, never less.

autoReply.note: An automatic reply is ignored completely (priority low, no draft, no queue), so these patterns are narrow on purpose: a client writing 'Delivery status of my documents' must not match. no-reply addresses are NOT treated as automatic replies, because courts often send notices from them.

counselGreeting: A line that starts with 'Counsel,' also counts. These cues are things a client or a first-time visitor would not normally write. A hit sends the message to the matter attorney and no reply is drafted.
